zh.title: 波音787-9居2026年廣體機交付首位 加速三款舊機型退役
zh.summary: 根據報導，波音787-9於2026年成為全球交付量最高的廣體客機。隨著波音787-9機型持續引進與交付，該機型的到來正進一步加速四家航空公司旗下共三款舊型客機的退役歷程。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，波音 787-9 機型在 2026 年的廣體客機交付數量中位居首位，成為該年度全球交付量最多的廣體客機。此項交付統計反應出該款機型在當前民航市場中的交機規模。
隨著新一批波音 787-9 廣體客機陸續交付，該機型的到來正進一步加速機隊的更新換代。據報導，波音 787-9 的引進正加速四家航空公司旗下共計三款舊型客機的退役歷程。
此項機隊轉型影響涵蓋多家營運業者，透過引進波音 787-9 提升營運效率，並逐步淘汰較舊款式的客機機隊。

en.title: Boeing 787-9 Leads 2026 Widebody Deliveries, Accelerating Older Aircraft Retirements
en.summary: According to a report by Simple Flying, the Boeing 787-9 has emerged as the most-delivered widebody aircraft globally in 2026. The steady arrival and introduction of these new Boeing 787-9 aircraft are currently accelerating the retirement phase of three older legacy aircraft models across four commercial airlines. As new deliveries proceed throughout the year, these fleet adjustments reflect broader airline operational transitions and ongoing efforts by multiple international carriers to replace aging legacy twin-aisle equipment with modern widebody passenger jets.
body: The Boeing 787-9 is leading widebody aircraft deliveries in 2026, positioning the model as the most-delivered twin-aisle passenger aircraft of the year, according to report details published by Simple Flying.

The ongoing arrival of these newly delivered Boeing 787-9 twinjets is actively accelerating the retirement process of three legacy aircraft types. Across four commercial airlines, operators are replacing older passenger jets as these new widebody aircraft enter active airline service.
The transition highlights current fleet planning adjustments within the commercial airline sector, where new long-haul aircraft deliveries directly support the phase-out of older legacy fleet types.
